name: DTMAPI 矿井
author: DTMAPI
description: DTMAPI experimental 矿井内容包。新增矿井设备、设备工作台配方，并通过 DTMAPI Machine API 声明燃料/耗电/概率产矿方案。

localized_description.schinese: 新增矿井设备和配方，复用官方水井素材但不替换水井；生产、燃料、耗电和兼容模组矿物由 DTMAPI experimental Machine API 承接。
localized_description.tchinese: 新增礦井設備和配方，複用官方水井素材但不替換水井；生產、燃料、耗電和相容模組礦物由 DTMAPI experimental Machine API 承接。
localized_description.english: Adds a mine equipment item and recipe, reuses the official well sprite without replacing the well, and declares production/fuel/electric behavior through the experimental DTMAPI Machine API.
